scope: Placental-transfer assessment clinical review only; not full-module verification
sourceNotes: MotherToBaby actual HTML dated April1,2025 read in this pass; primary DailyMed sections read in preceding pass. No source diagram reproduced.

questions.review: All four options reviewed. Key2 correctly rejects a universal size cutoff. Three distractors incorrectly make size, lipid solubility or binding sufficient to prove exclusion or safety. Current infliximab labeling provides the large-molecule transfer counterexample.
All four options reviewed. Key3 distinguishes measured exposure from outcome evidence. Neither malformation causation, no effects, nor risk magnitude follows from detection alone.
All four options reviewed. Key0 retains neonatal effects after organogenesis. Other options incorrectly dismiss late exposure or restrict evaluation to first-trimester structural defects.

All four options reviewed. Key2 checks dating, persistence and drug-specific exceptions. One postconception week is approximately three gestational weeks, not one. Neither guaranteed safety nor predicted malformation follows from the date alone.

visualTextReview.finding: Title and all three column labels/details preserve multifactorial exposure and developmental timing. No absolute molecular-weight or trimester cutoff. This is a text review, not a new screenshot inspection.

limitations: Full module clinical review and consolidated assessment UI remain open.
Object hashes preserve reviewed versions; hashes alone do not establish accuracy.
